scope: single release repository and explicit tool

verification.command: Phase 4A live closure and Phase 4B current-schema/store review
verification.summary: Phase 4A is merged and live-verified while formalActiveManifest remains false. Existing gear/community tables are confirmed mutable staging, so the 4B plan adds separate immutable release-scoped storage rather than changing staging ownership.

The Slice is limited to additive schema, one repository/tool and inactive legacy import. Shadow readers, pointer cutover and scheduled refresh remain separate 4C-4E gates; public observed-only/baseline-empty, PG-only and Catalyst fail-closed contracts are unchanged.

risks.detail: Release content permits insert/select only; identical inserts are idempotent and hash/content mismatch must fail closed.
Migration creates separate tables and the tool snapshots staging; existing sync writers and public selectors remain unchanged.
Community import must re-author exact Intent and run the current Resolver against the candidate Gear Release; rejected rows remain internal.
No public release reader or active pointer mutation is allowed in Slice 4B; formalActiveManifest remains false.

summary: Slice 4B is implementation-allowed only after this Phase 4A closure packet lands. No migration, release table, import, reader, pointer or scheduled refresh has been implemented or claimed.
